submission.implementation_notes: Revision 2 of the scenario (thread token): one script that runs as a minting policy for the token and as a spending validator for the funds, and reads its own hash from the script context. In revision 2 this variant has the validator text of the plain family (`Plinth_1.45.0.0_Unisay_plain`): typed `PlutusLedgerApi.Data.V3` matching and a derived single-field `EscrowDatum`, with mint entries and the deposit datum compared by `Data` equality. It pulls in no `lib/Plinth/` module, so it shows hand-written code on the 1.67 compiler next to the decoder DSL of `Plinth_1.67.0.0_Unisay`; both rows share one source commit. Compiled with Plinth 1.67.0.0; the default `SumsOfProducts` enables builtin casing without a flag. Requires protocol version 11 (van Rossem), live on mainnet since 2026-07-18. No inliner pragma. Source: `lib/TwoPartyEscrow/AsData.hs` (+ `lib/TwoPartyEscrow/Fixture.hs`) in plinth-cape-submissions @ 814c7fc0f262e86ea7fd6a45e9e5b3c54d42374f.
